messages:
eli_cs: Heads-up from onboarding calls today 4 notes clustering around product asks + one clear renewal risk. Sharing quick buckets so we can triage before Tue renewal review. Please add reactions or reply with action.
sunita_onboard: saw similar in two trial accounts (Brightlane + Clearpath). Quick quotes: 'we need cost clarity per-route' and 'latency spikes during bursts'.
parker_prod: paste the aggregated asks and severity; I'll slot into the product intake and give rough LOE.
eli_cs: aggregated asks: 
- 'per-route cost export' -> customers want downloadable CSV / Excel showing per-route & per-environment cost, filter by date + tags. (severity: high; 1 account flagged as renewal-risk)
- 'burst-aware latency mode' -> ability to prefer low-latency at cost of throughput for specific routes or during business hours. (severity: medium)
- 'scheduled embedding reindex' -> TTL or cron-based re-embed for streaming doc ingestion (severity: medium-high)
- 'onboarding playbook snippets' -> short step-by-step guides in Console for common setup (severity: low)
sunita_onboard: Brightlane explicitly said the per-route export is "must-have for finance". Renewal conversation in ~5 weeks.
ravi_eng: Quick clarifying Qs: for per-route export do they expect server-side breakdown vs sampled estimates? Also burst-aware mode sounds like an autoscaling/policy config. Any preference on UI vs API?
eli_cs: they want server-side authoritative numbers (not sampled) and a UI export plus API endpoint for finance automation. Burst-mode should be a route-level toggle in Console with an option to set latency-priority.
parker_prod: Proposed triage: 
* P0: per-route cost export for accounts with renewals in <8 weeks (schedule spike if needed).
* P1: scheduled embeddings reindex (medium-high impact, fits batch infra).
* P2: burst-aware latency mode + onboarding snippets (collect UX examples).
eli_cs: request: mark Brightlane as "high risk" in renewal tracker and add this thread to product sync agenda.
sync_bot: Reminder: CS/Product weekly sync in 36 hours 4:00 PT. Thread auto-added to agenda under "renewal risks".
parker_prod: Action items: 
- @ravi_eng investigate cost-export feasibility & estimated effort (ETA 3d).
- @sunita_onboard collate call transcripts and attach two direct quotes to GH issue.
- @eli_cs update renewal tracker.
ravi_eng: I'll prototype an export schema: columns -> date, route, env, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, tokens_cost_usd, api_calls, avg_latency_ms. Will post a sample CSV by EOD.
sunita_onboard: adding transcripts to GH issue now and tagging @parker_prod @ravi_eng.
eli_cs: thanks all. If we can get the CSV sample and a short LOE by EOD we can include a mitigation ask in the renewal outreach. :pray:
parker_prod: noted. I'll bring a 5-min wireframe for the export UI to the product sync.
eli_cs: ack, adding wireframe request to the renewal playbook.
